attr.title: OpenUG2 (NFS Underground 2)
attr.desc: Experimental native ARM64/OpenGL ES2 engine for NFS Underground 2. Basic driving, AI and career prototype; requires own PC game data. H700 device playthrough not yet verified.
attr.inst: Copy legally owned PC game data to openug2/game (TRACKS, CARS, etc.); place an H700-compatible ARM64 binary as openug2/nfsu2 or openug2/nfsu2.aarch64.
